placements.title: Processed transcripts outlast ephemeral raw field recordings
placements.frame: How does retention policy distinguish between transient raw capture and permanent archival record?
placements.why: Establishes a dual-tier archival retention policy where raw audio recordings are ephemeral (18 months) while textual transcripts are preserved permanently.

placements.title: Systemic diagnosis begins with frontline operational teams before management review
placements.frame: How does sequencing discovery interviews from frontline warehouse operations upward ensure diagnostic integrity?
placements.why: Defines an operational diagnostic sequence prioritizing frontline warehouse staff interviews prior to engaging management layers.

placements.title: Orchard interventions synchronize with post-frost seasonal thresholds
placements.frame: When do seasonal climatic thresholds dictate the execution window for agricultural intervention?
placements.why: Establishes environmental dependency where orchard grafting operations are scheduled strictly after frost risk subsides in late March.
